north_star: CTI becomes world-shaking only if cheap pre-evaluation geometry can predict, diagnose, and eventually steer useful model behavior under held-out families and causal local-field interventions.
why_current_state_is_not_enough: The source law is strong but scoped.
Decision-margin local surgery has source-family and fresh-family fixed-dose mechanism passes at strengths 1.25 and 1.5, but no threshold derivation or public downstream transfer yet.
The downstream public benchmark bridge is preregistered but not run.
H3 Banking77 utility is internal evidence only.
External 2026 geometry literature favors calibrated local neighborhoods and intrinsic dimension, not broad global-transfer stories.

question_first_budget.rule: Every trial must begin with frozen questions, proof obligations, and kill criteria before new results are treated as evidence.

current_claim_ladder.claim: Within the source NLP-decoder scope, the EVT-derived functional law is strong.
A coupled local competition field repairs dataset and family transfer better than centroid-only geometry.
Exact held-out decision-margin surgery passes source-family and fresh-family fixed-dose local mechanism gates.
Uncalibrated q-free architecture invariance is false.
The frozen v7 q-free prediction-set protocol is a promising scope contract.
CTI predicts public LLM downstream benchmark generalization.

Which task family breaks first: instruction following, reasoning, math, science QA, long-context reasoning, or multitask knowledge?
If only the total correlation passes, is CTI just tracking scale?
Can local safe rate be changed while centroid kappa stays approximately fixed?
Can lower-tail margin be changed without moving the mean centroid separation?
Does q move with the local-field perturbation or with kappa?
Which intervention creates the cleanest paired contrast: prototype injection, hard-negative pruning, covariance reshaping, or class-tail resampling?
Can the perturbation prediction be frozen before the target labels or q values are measured?
Does CTI's local field survive permutation-null calibration across architectures?
Does local-neighborhood agreement predict CTI scope passes and misses better than global spectral metrics?
Can Genome/Rosetta negative results and CTI local-field positives become one calibrated neighborhood-invariant story?
Do nearest-neighbor relationships, not distances, explain why kappa survives in some regimes and fails in others?
Can the local-field panel be derived from a finite-sample point process rather than regression search?
What EVT object corresponds to lower-tail margin?
How does local intrinsic dimension enter the denominator of the competition law?
What term predicts the Falcon/Zamba/Granite failure modes before q is measured?
What theorem would make the supported object a law rather than a calibrated instrument?
Can v7 survive a fresh target where it must abstain rather than produce an easy singleton pass?
Can it confidently warn on a fresh target and contain the truth after q?
Which target falsifies the prediction-set contract rather than merely adding another failure mode?
Does a gated-attention or linear-attention family create a new basin outside the known MoE/hybrid failures?

trial_ladder.primary_question: Can CTI geometry predict public LLM benchmark performance under held-out model families?
trial_ladder.why_it_matters: This is the strict metric named by _meta and Open Exploration: geometry must predict held-out behavior, not just internal representation rows.
proof_obligations: Repair lm-eval environment in an isolated or pinned eval environment.
Freeze model revisions and CTI geometry packet before public benchmark outputs are read.
Run the six-task leaderboard panel for at least 12 models and 4 families.
Report total-panel correlation, permutation p, leave-one-family-out macro Spearman, partial Spearman after log params, and baseline deltas.

pass_rule.leave_one_family_out_negative_folds: 0 when held-out family has at least 3 models
pass_rule.baseline_guard: Primary CTI score must beat log-parameter-count and generic spectral geometry baselines by at least +0.10 Spearman on the complete panel.

trial_ladder.kill_rule: Keep CTI as a representation-quality/scope law and remove public downstream benchmark prediction from paper-facing language.
trial_ladder.next_action: Build an isolated eval environment and a frozen geometry packet; do not launch partial benchmark runs first.

trial_ladder.primary_question: Can CTI causally move q by changing the exact held-out 1-NN decision margin while holding centroid kappa approximately fixed?
trial_ladder.why_it_matters: A causal local-field contrast distinguishes CTI from generic spectral geometry and from post-hoc calibration.
proof_obligations: Preserve the source-family and fresh-family fixed-strength 1.25 and 1.5 results as scoped mechanism evidence, not public downstream proof.
Explain why strength 1.25 succeeds while strength 1.0 fails.
Compare decision-margin surgery against effective rank, local intrinsic dimension, Fisher ratio, and log parameter count on the next preregistered threshold trial.
Show whether the intervention predicts public downstream behavior or only local representation-quality q.
trial_ladder.kill_rule: If the threshold trial inside (1.0, 1.25] is unstable across families or downstream transfer fails, keep decision-margin surgery as a replicated local intervention rather than a universal causal mechanism.
trial_ladder.next_action: Preregister a threshold search inside (1.0, 1.25] before adding another descriptive local-geometry metric.

trial_ladder.primary_question: Does CTI's local competition field survive calibrated local-neighborhood null tests across model families?
trial_ladder.why_it_matters: The strongest 2026 external geometry result says local neighborhoods survive while global spectral convergence is confounded.
proof_obligations: Run permutation-null calibration for local-neighborhood similarity and global spectral metrics on the same model set.
Test whether calibrated local-neighborhood scores separate CTI pass, partial-pass, abstain, and break basins.
Require negative controls where global spectral metrics look strong before calibration.

pass_rule.global_spectral_control: not sufficient to explain scope labels after calibration

trial_ladder.kill_rule: If calibrated local-neighborhood scores do not improve over global spectral or size controls, stop framing CTI as aligned with the Aristotelian invariant.
trial_ladder.next_action: Build a small calibration harness that consumes frozen CTI representations and produces permutation-null scores.

trial_ladder.primary_question: Can the local-field panel be derived from EVT, point-process, and intrinsic-dimension assumptions?
trial_ladder.why_it_matters: The law becomes field-changing only if the local-field terms are not just regression features.
proof_obligations: Derive a finite-sample term for nearest impostor pressure.
Show how local intrinsic dimension changes lower-tail margin and safe-rate probability.
Recover the existing alpha/kappa law as a limiting or special case.
Produce a falsifiable correction term that predicts one known scope break before q.
trial_ladder.kill_rule: If no derivation connects local-field terms to finite-sample competition, publish CTI as an empirical law and stop implying theoretical completeness.
trial_ladder.next_action: Draft theorem obligations first; do not retrofit theory after another empirical win.

trial_ladder.primary_question: Can v7 survive a fresh target whose geometry forces abstention or warning rather than an easy pass?
trial_ladder.why_it_matters: LFM2 was a good prospective singleton success, but one easy success is not scope-model validation.
proof_obligations: Select a fresh open target before q-bearing rows exist.
Score v7 on q-withheld geometry rows only.
Prefer target families likely to test a new basin: gated attention, linear attention, hybrid SSM, or sparse MoE variant.
Audit q after the prediction set is frozen and record contains-truth and singleton/abstention behavior.
trial_ladder.kill_rule: If v7 falsely excludes a fresh target truth label, demote it to a historical compression of the current architecture table.
trial_ladder.next_action: Search fresh open targets and freeze a target before q-bearing rows are generated.

trial_ladder.primary_question: Can CTI predict natural OOD confusion deltas before target labels are evaluated?
trial_ladder.why_it_matters: Synthetic confusion surgery shows mechanism; natural shift prediction shows field utility.

current_evidence.contract_scope: representation quality and confusion geometry, not broad OOD reliability yet

proof_obligations: Choose paired source/OOD datasets with stable label spaces.
Freeze source nearest-class geometry and predicted brittle class pairs.
Evaluate target confusion only after predictions are committed.
Report per-class sign accuracy, pair-level rank correlation, and failure modes orthogonal to centroid competition.
trial_ladder.kill_rule: If natural-shift failures are orthogonal to centroid/local competition, keep CTI out of broad reliability forecasting language.
trial_ladder.next_action: Identify a stable-label OOD pair and write a prediction file before running target labels.

decision_policy.ship_now: Scoped CTI representation-quality law plus falsifier-rich contract.
do_not_ship: local field as universal causal mechanism outside the replicated fixed-dose decision-margin scope
promotion_requires: or point_process_evt_derivation with an independently verified finite-sample correction
